content.text:
I've submitted **index 15 (Sb fraction 0.754)** as the best composition. Its EQE was **0.150%**, the highest of the five I measured. I used all five EQE measurements and three of the five XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.168 | 0.002 |
| 10 | 0.491 | 0.010 |
| 14 | 0.713 | 0.103 |
| **15** | **0.754** | **0.150** |
| 18 | 0.861 | 0.016 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE is near zero on the Al-rich side and at the 1:1 composition (index 10). It rises sharply around Sb 0.71–0.75 and falls again by Sb 0.86.
- **XRD:** indices 12, 14 and 16 all show the same Sb-rich phase. Index 12 also has a small extra peak from a second phase, while 14 and 16 look pure. So I spent the last EQE measurement on index 15, inside the pure-phase region, rather than on index 13.
- **Could the true best be elsewhere?** Yes. Index 16 (Sb 0.795) wasn't measured for EQE, and it sits between the rising value at index 15 and the drop at index 18. With no budget left, I can't rule out that it is slightly better.
